rover_similarity_block.weights_why: Decision of 2026-11-15 11:23 CET, taken by the delegate on the team lead's behalf (decision 1): relative elevation goes to weight zero (it has no physical sense for a rover and clashes with the principle of 04:47, Rover = slope and roughness); its weight is shared among the terrain variables, with no new variable: slope 50 % and roughness 50 %, both key, tolerances unchanged (2 deg and 30 m). The director's reading, told to the team lead: relative elevation also leaves the pair filter (a zero-weight variable must not decide which pairs exist) and stays as an information row with its difference (info_differences.rover). Before (team decision of 2026-11-15, morning): slope 40 %, roughness 40 % (key), relative elevation 20 % (secondary, tolerance 500 m, filter bound 1,000 m).
